about_the_game:
🚀 In Development!

Life Core is currently in development, and we are working hard to deliver the best possible gameplay experience. We are continuously refining combat mechanics, enemy designs, and progression systems to create the most engaging action-packed journey!

Explore, Fight, Die, Evolve, and Repeat!

Life Core is a roguelite action game featuring uncharted planetary exploration and fast-paced, fluid combat. Death is inevitable, but not the end—unleash the power of the Core in your new body and continue the fight. As you venture deeper into the unknown, each new planet brings you closer to a greater truth…

Die and Grow Stronger

Each defeat is just the beginning. Face relentless enemies, fall in battle, and rise again with permanent upgrades that make you stronger for your next expedition. Adapt, improve, and push further with every cycle.

Explore Planets, Wield the Power Bestowed Upon You

Travel across diverse planets, each with unique biomes and hostile creatures standing in your way. Guided by the System and the power it grants you, eliminate all opposition and uncover the secrets hidden within each world.

Forge Unique and Powerful Playstyles

With every reward, choose from a variety of enhancements that shape your playstyle. Experiment with different builds and abilities, ensuring that no two runs ever feel the same.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 x64 (Version 1909 or newer)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4670K (4 * 3400) / AMD FX-8350 (4 * 4000)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 960 (2048 MB) / AMD Radeon RX 470 (2048 MB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 x64 (Version 1909 or newer)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-6700K (4 * 4000) / AMD Ryzen 5 1500X (4 * 3500)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 970 (2048 MB) / Radeon R9 Fury (4096 MB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: Life Core is a roguelite action game where you explore uncharted planets. Fight, eliminate your enemies, and when you fall, unleash the power of the Core in your new body. But remember… the system is always watching!
